items.q: What does a digital marketing fresher do day to day?
items.a: Typical work is keyword research, writing posts and captions, setting up small ad campaigns, checking analytics and preparing weekly reports under a senior marketer.

items.q: Can I start freelancing in digital marketing?
items.a: Yes. Many learners take small projects such as local business social media or Google Business Profile work while building a portfolio of results.

items.q: Which digital marketing skills should I learn first?
items.a: Begin with how search and social platforms work, then pick one specialisation: SEO, social media, performance marketing or content. Add analytics and AI tools alongside.

items.q: Do I need to learn coding for a digital marketing career?
items.a: Not for most roles. Basic HTML helps for SEO and landing pages, and web development is a separate career path you can add later.

items.q: Where can I learn digital marketing with live projects?
items.a: Our classroom course in Bhopal and online course teach it with live projects and placement support.
